verdict.rationale: Installing a collection is one documented one-liner, `npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills`. It accepts GitHub, GitLab, Azure, URL and local sources, offers non-interactive and global flags, and writes skills into each targeted agent's skills directory, with 75+ agents supported. The Agent Skills docs state agents load available skills at startup, so installed skills are active in the next session. A runtime probe confirmed the CLI runs keylessly from npm and auto-switches to non-interactive mode. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that an installed collection actually appears in a fresh agent session (the probe only ran `--version` and `--list`, not a full install).
